method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: One panorama about 4.8 m from the Proviantgatan front, resected on the south corner in one heading and the north corner in another; the three windows seen in both headings agree within 0.1 m. The base row puts the camera 2.51 m high. The roof is barely seen and is an estimate, as are the Storgatan and yard sides (Storgatan has no Street View here).
